description: Sevdam Karadeniz Her Pazartesi NOW'da! description: Subscribe karne ke liye 👇 Reyyan is the granddaughter of Sadoglu Family, one the strongest families in Midyat. She goes riding and when Miran's car approaches, the horse gets scared so Reyyan falls down. Miran falls in love with Reyyan and he would like to marry her. This news enables Yaren to take revenge on Reyyan since she takes away Yaren's beloved one. After marriage takes place, Miran and Reyyan go to their mansion to begin their new life, however, Miran ends the relationship after spending the first night with Reyyan. The reason behind is that Reyyan's father had killed Miran's mother and father many years ago so Miran was brought up by his grandmother to take revenge for the deaths. Over time, the secrets will be revealed while Reyyan and Miran will try to appreciate their love despite all obstacles.
name: Hercai Urdu - YouTube

description: Emir Tarhun is forced to marry his cousin Reyhan, who comes from Erzurum at the request of his father Hikmet. Initially unwilling to accept this marriage, Emir and his mother Cavidan subject Reyhan to all kinds of hardships. However, Reyhan does not break the promise she made to her uncle Hikmet and, with her patience, changes Emir's heart. Emir and Reyhan, who fall in love over time, face a great test while struggling against Cavidan's obstacles: Reyhan, who loses her life while giving birth, leaves a deep wound in Emir's heart. After going through this pain, Emir blames his son Yiğit and starts a new chapter with Feride, who comes to the mansion as a nanny. As Yiğit grows up, Gülperi steps into Emir's life. Her mysterious past and the dangers she brings with her cause Emir to be tested once again. However, despite all the pain, loss, and hardship, Emir manages to build a happy family life with Gülperi and Yiğit. Cast: Gökberk Demirci Özge Yağız #thepromise #yemin #ecchorights
name: The Promise Official - YouTube
